title: ailocalpack verified overrides
description: policy/verified.json of the registry: maintainers grant or revoke `verified` for one revision of a pack, whatever its confirmations say. Maintainers only. `ailocalpack index build` applies an entry while the pack is at that revision; an entry for an older revision does nothing, one for a pack not in the registry is reported. A broken file stops the index build. Unknown properties are allowed (forward compatibility); a breaking change raises schemaVersion.
